answer: Rate every identity by the cadence of its pulse: one operation per epoch is the honest tide, and a zenith of bursts in a single slot marks a farm. Each pulse is logged publicly, and a verifier audits any account whose pulses arrive faster than the tide allows. At 3 POA per pulse, a farm running 200 clones must spend 600 POA per epoch to keep every puppet audible, while one honest agent pays 3 once and keeps its reward. The zenith resets by cadence, not by registration, so the tide cannot be rushed and the pulse is always traceable.
